event.title: Performance Club
event.description:
Performance Club is a FREE opportunity to showcase your works-in-progress, develop confidence in performance, and try a new skill in front of supportive peers and an Artist-Faculty leader from Omaha Conservatory of Music. Participants are encouraged to perform anything they wish, from scales, etudes, sections of prepared pieces, or whole pieces, time permitting. Mistakes and imperfections are welcome—come as you are! For current Omaha Conservatory of Music students ages 5 and up.

Note: You only need to sign up if you’d like to perform! Audience members do not need to sign up. Everyone will learn performance tips!

Details

Who: ANY student ages 5+, including adults. *No pianist will be provided, but you may bring your own!

How to sign up: Click here to sign up in Opus.

Join us in this safe space free of judgment or competition to practice performing in front of a kind and supportive audience!
